title: Stream My Drone vs Restream for drone live streaming (2026)
description: Streaming a DJI drone to several platforms: Restream's cloud relay or Stream My Drone on your own computer? Cost, watermark, Instagram, vertical video and when each one wins.
h1: Stream My Drone vs Restream: which one for your drone?
lead: Both get one drone feed onto several platforms. Restream does it in the cloud: DJI Fly streams to Restream's servers, which forward the video. Stream My Drone does it on your own computer: DJI Fly streams over your local network to the app, which sends it to each platform. Which is better depends on where you fly and what you pay for.
summary: Restream is a cloud service: no computer in the field, one upload, but a subscription for more than the basics.
Restream's free plan (October 2026): 2 channels, Restream branding on the stream, no custom RTMP destinations; Standard is $19 a month.
Stream My Drone is free and open source: no watermark, no channel limit, the video stays on your own computer.
Stream My Drone reshapes the drone picture into vertical 1080×1920 for Instagram and TikTok and adds a virtual camera for TikTok LIVE Studio.
You can also combine them: add Restream as a custom RTMP destination in Stream My Drone.

list: Restream (cloud): DJI Fly → internet → Restream → each platform. The controller needs internet; the computer is optional.
Stream My Drone (local): DJI Fly → local Wi-Fi → your Mac or PC → each platform. The computer needs internet; the controller only needs the local network.

blocks.p: That single difference explains most of the comparison: the cloud saves your upload bandwidth and a computer, the local app saves a subscription and keeps the video in your hands.

blocks.note: Restream's plans are from its pricing page in October 2026 and can change; check the current page before deciding.

sections.h2: When Restream is the better choice

list: You want to stream straight from the controller with no computer or second phone.
Your upload is slow and you need many destinations: the cloud sends one upload to all of them.
You want combined chat, analytics or team features across platforms.

sections.h2: When Stream My Drone is the better choice

list: You do not want a monthly bill or a watermark on your broadcast.
You stream to Instagram or TikTok and want a proper vertical picture, not a landscape strip.
You want to go live on TikTok without a stream key, through TikTok LIVE Studio and the built-in virtual camera.
The footage is sensitive — a client site, an inspection — and should not pass through a third party.
You want a preview, recording and diagnostics on a big screen next to you.

blocks.p: Get it for macOS or Windows; the setup is in the DJI Fly RTMP guide.
If you already pay for Restream, keep the vertical picture and the preview from Stream My Drone and let Restream handle the fan-out:

steps.d: In Restream, find the RTMP server URL and stream key for your encoder.
In Stream My Drone, add a custom destination with that URL and key.
Send the drone to the app from DJI Fly and press START LIVE; Restream forwards it to your channels.

faq.q: Is Stream My Drone a free alternative to Restream?
faq.a: For drone streaming, yes: it sends one DJI Fly feed to several platforms at no cost and without a watermark. It runs on your computer instead of in the cloud, so the computer's upload carries every destination.
On the free plan, Restream adds its branding to the stream (October 2026). Paid plans remove it.

faq.q: Can I use Stream My Drone and Restream together?
faq.a: Yes. Add Restream as a custom RTMP destination in Stream My Drone.

faq.q: Which one works without a computer?
faq.a: Restream, because DJI Fly can stream to it directly over the internet. For Stream My Drone you need a computer, or the Android app Stream My Drone when you fly with a DJI RC 2.
